captions: 4:30 a.m. alarm. Headlamp on. No snooze. Not once.
Last week you set an alarm too. For Fajr.
Day one. Day two. Day three. Then: “I'm too tired.”
Now the sun breaks over the clouds. Everyone films it.
And you think: He made all this. I couldn't give Him ten minutes.
Next morning, 6:10. No mountain. Just your bathroom sink.
Cold water on your face. Day one. Again.
No streak to protect. Just Him, waiting for you.
You fell on day three. He never stopped calling.

post.caption:
1,200 metres for a sunrise. 3 days was your limit for Fajr. 🌙

4:30 a.m., headlamp on, no snooze — for a mountain. For Fajr you made it to day three. He made that sunrise. And He never stopped calling.

“So do not weaken and do not grieve.” (3:139)

Right now: set your alarm for Fajr. Day one, again.
